parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the protective cap of a USB flash drive, made of plastic, typically transparent or opaque, covering the metal connector.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the USB connector from dust, moisture, and physical damage when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It can be detached or slid off the base body to expose the USB connector.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB flash drive, made of durable plastic, housing the memory chip and connector interface.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the electronic components for data storage and provides the structure for handling and connecting the device.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, except for insertion or removal from a USB port.
